statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), Function.Surjective fun x => x ^ (2 * k + 1)
script:
# name: set-odd-pow-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Surjective.odd_pow_surjective
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0'], True, 'have key : ∀ (k : ℕ), Function.Surjective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 * k + 1)) := by
  intro k
  intro y
  have hn : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  rcases le_or_gt 0 y with hy | hy
  · refine ⟨y ^ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one]
  · refine ⟨-((-y) ^ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹), ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨k, rfl⟩, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith),
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one, neg_neg]
exact @key (0)'),
    (['1'], False, 'have key : ∀ (k : ℕ), Function.Surjective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 * k + 1)) := by
  intro k
  intro y
  have hn : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega

    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one]
  · refine ⟨-((-y) ^ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹), ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨k, rfl⟩, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith),
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one, neg_neg]
exact @key (1)'),
    (['2'], False, 'have key : ∀ (k : ℕ), Function.Surjective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 * k + 1)) := by
  intro k
  intro y
  have hn : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  rcases le_or_gt 0 y with hy | hy
  · refine ⟨y ^ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one]
  · refine ⟨-((-y) ^ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹), ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨k, rfl⟩, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith),
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one, neg_neg]
exact @key (2)'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
